title: SB2781 (2018 Regular): Concealed carry permit; revise term and fee.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Mississippi) (gun-policy Stage 5, Mississippi); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (Introduced; official copy, https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/documents/2018/html/SB/2700-2799/SB2781IN.htm)
provenance.note: Introduced text. Struck: five (5) years, $80 fee, $40 renewal, $20 renewal for 65+. Quote joins fragments of separate subsections. No passage vote on record.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Miss. Code § 45-9-101): Such licenses shall be valid throughout the state for a period of ten (10) years from the date of issuance. A nonrefundable license fee of One Hundred Forty Dollars ($140.00). Except as provided in this subsection, a renewal fee of Seventy Dollars ($70.00) shall also be submitted along with costs for processing the fingerprints; The renewal fee for a Mississippi resident aged sixty-five (65) years of age or older shall be Thirty Dollars ($30.00).
Section 1 (Miss. Code § 45-9-101): A license under this section is not required for a loaded or unloaded pistol or revolver to be carried upon the person in a pocket, sheath, belt holster or shoulder holster or in a purse, handbag, satchel, other similar bag or briefcase or fully enclosed case if the person is not engaged in criminal activity other than a misdemeanor traffic offense, is not otherwise prohibited from possessing a pistol or revolver under state or federal law, and is not in a location prohibited under subsection (13) of this section.
